title: Mostra's MCP tools: the input schema of each tool

dir.description: Where to create it: a directory that doesn't exist yet or is empty. Without it, a new folder in the workspace, named after the title.

template.description: A template to start from (none by default).

artifact.description: The artifact: its ID (art_…), or its directory as artifact_create returned it.

version.description: A new link that opens only this version (its number or ID).

viewer.description: A new link for one person: their own draft and, under once per-viewer, their own submission.

ref.description: Your own stable key for the person, such as their email.

scopes.description: A new link that allows only these: view, draft, submit, review, signal, action:*, action:<name>.

ttl.description: A new link that stops working after this long, such as 24h or 7d.

open.description: Also open the link in a browser on this computer, for the person sitting at it.

dir.description: The artifact's directory: an absolute path, or a name inside the workspace folder (the server's instructions name it).

path.description: The file to change, relative to the artifact's directory. Needed with edits; with a diff, it overrides the file the diff names.

old.description: Text that appears exactly once in the file (empty to write a new file).

diff.description: A unified diff of one or more files.

dir.description: The artifact's directory: an absolute path, or a name inside the workspace folder (the server's instructions name it).

force.description: Publish even though verify reports errors; the version records them.

artifact.description: The artifact: its ID (art_…), or its directory as artifact_create returned it.

submission.description: A submission's ID (sub_…); the latest by default.

format.description: md (the default): Markdown to read; json: the full Results structure.

dir.description: The artifact's directory: an absolute path, or a name inside the workspace folder (the server's instructions name it).

screenshots.description: Which screenshots come back as images: on-failure (the default), always (to look at the page), or never.

artifact.description: The artifact: its ID (art_…), or its directory as artifact_create returned it.

until.description: submitted, submitted:all (every expected respondent), submitted:<N>, signal:<name>, state:<fieldId> or event:<type> (event:submission.* matches a family).

after.description: Wait for what happens after this cursor: the one a previous wait returned.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait, at most 50 seconds (the default); 0 checks once.

dir.description: The artifact's directory: an absolute path, or a name inside the workspace folder (the server's instructions name it).

files.description: Files to write, each replaced whole.

path.description: Relative to the artifact's directory, such as index.tsx or components/chart.tsx.

encoding.description: utf8 (the default) for text; base64 for an image or other binary file.

deletes.description: Files to delete, relative to the artifact's directory.

query.description: What you want to know, in a few words.

topic.description: A topic to read whole instead, such as guide, guide/answers or a diagnostic code.

artifact.description: The artifact: its ID (art_…), or its directory as artifact_create returned it.

value.description: Any JSON value, at most 4 MiB.

mode.description: replace (the default): the new latest value; append: also kept in the source's ring.

artifact.description: The artifact: its ID (art_…), or its directory as artifact_create returned it.

ids.description: Only these field IDs; every field by default.

artifact.description: The artifact: its ID (art_…), or its directory as artifact_create returned it.

baseRevision.description: The revision you last read: fields changed after it aren't overwritten and come back in conflicts.

mutationId.description: Your ID for this change (mut_ and a ULID), so a retry applies it once; one is made when you leave it out.
